{{Quote|My mother worked at a food-processing plant until brownlung killed her. I worked there for a season before I was well established enough to make my living with my blastsword.|Cheriss ke Hanadi to Wedge Antilles|<ref name="sof" />}}
This '''Human female''' was the mother of [[Cheriss ke Hanadi]], a renowned [[blastsword]] duelist from the nation of [[Cartann]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]].<ref name="sof" />

She worked in a food-processing plant until she [[Death/Legends|died]] from the [[brownlung]] disease.<ref name="sof" />
